runtime.clock: Core stream admission through event drain and bounded worker/cancel settlement; excludes backend preflight, preparation, close and independent oracle
runtime.parent_identity_source: typed original top-level tool.result receipts bound to the exact admitted Run

metrics.limits: Parent IDs come from the actual model transcript. ToolStart-to-ToolEnd intervals include preparation unless an execution-start event narrows them. Parent intervals may contain children; do not add their durations. Program child intervals use per-program monotonic clocks, so separate programs' unions are not a global child union. Child receipt bytes reflect retained bounded output. Zero-only normalized token usage cannot establish provider reporting. VM counts require independent runtime observations; Bash calls do not establish VM counts.

runtime_observations.source: OCI execute span and successful vm_create event; complete phases and closed spans required; never inferred from Bash calls

runtime.token_limit_semantics: reported-token soft cap; missing provider usage is not estimated
